title: The library's functions
description:
Write the two functions the StoneMath DLL in the lesson exports. On the website they are ordinary functions; in Visual Studio the same code goes into the DLL project.

- `int stackHeight(int stones, int stonesPerLayer)`: how many layers a stack of stones makes. A part layer still counts as a layer. If `stonesPerLayer` is 0 or less, or there are no stones, the answer is 0.
- `double stackWeight(int stones, double kilosEach)`: the total weight.

```
stackHeight(10, 4) == 3
stackWeight(10, 2.5) == 25.0
```
hints: Rounding a division up: `(a + b - 1) / b` for positive whole numbers.
lessonTitle: Your First DLL in Visual Studio
